description: This file is a PHP source file that generates a web page for configuring email notifications related to security breaches and mail server settings on a gateway device. It includes server-side PHP code, embedded JavaScript for UI interactions and form validation, and HTML markup for the configuration form.

methods.name: button_save
methods.description: Gathers configuration data from the form fields, constructs a JSON string, and sends it via AJAX POST request to save email notification settings.
